title: Collins Market post review
subtitle: Drafts for the rest of November and December 2026
intro:
Here are the draft posts and stories for the rest of November and all of December. For each one, mark Approve, Reject, or Request changes. If a graphic is still needed, you can request that photo from the store. Nothing on this page gets published. Cory will schedule only what you approve.

If you have downtown events we should tie a post to, add them at the bottom before you submit.

posts.title: A Wharf with no water
posts.caption:
Why does Staunton have a Wharf with no waterfront?

The name comes from its days as a shipping point, not from a river landing. Next time you're downtown, look toward the warehouses and the tracks and you'll see why the name stuck.

Have you walked that part of town?

Downtown Fact Fridays, presented by Collins Market.

#CollinsMarket #DowntownStaunton #StauntonVA #FactFriday #StauntonHistory
posts.imageNote: Graphic needed, then a finished Reel. Please send a current photo of the Wharf warehouse fronts or the railroad area, filmed from public spaces. Do not invent extra historical details. Fact source: the Fact Friday Ideas tab (idea 2) and dhr.virginia.gov/historic-registers/132-0014.
placeholders: Need a photo of the Wharf warehouse fronts or the railroad area, taken from a public space, and permission to use it.
